lines.text: Many learners say: I can't listen to you well.
Better: I can't hear you well.
Hear is for the sound you get.
Hear! Sorry, I can't hear you.

data.wrong: I can't listen to you well.
data.why: Hear is for the sound you get.

native.caption: “I can't listen to you well”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 ‘잘 안 들려요’처럼 소리가 귀에 들어오는지를 말할 때는 listen이 아니라 hear를 써요. listen은 귀 기울여 듣는 것이에요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “I can't hear you well.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: For sound you cannot catch, say hear. Say “I can't hear you well.”
en.caption: Do you say “I can't listen to you well” in English? 😅 When you cannot catch the sound, say “hear”, not “listen”! “I can't hear you well” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
